met_analysis:
The Low Pressure area over North Myanmar and adjoining Mizoram-Tripura has become less markedat 0530 hrs IST of today, 2nd October 2026, however, the associated cyclonic circulation now lies between 3.1 & 5.8 km above mean sea level over the same region.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over Sikkim & neighbourhood between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The trough from Northeast Arabian sea to westcentral Arabian sea between 3.1 & 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam & neighbourhood now lies over central Assam & neighbourhoodand extends upto 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over East Uttar Pradesh & adjoining Bihar persists and now seen at 3.1 km above mean sea level.
A trough runs from West Uttar Pradesh to north Gujarat across East Rajasthan at 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The north-south trough from North Interior Karnataka to Gulf of Mannar across interior Karnataka and Tamil Nadu at 0.9 km above mean sea level has become less marked.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Coastal Tamil Nadu and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level has become less marked
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over north Haryana & neighbourhood between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level has become less marked. The trough aloft in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 72°E to the north of Lat. 26°N has moved away in east-northeastwards direction.
